info.name: DAtuviSezaH
info.value: asya DAtoH vizaye sidDAntakOmudyAm ucyate - 'ayaM sArvaDAtukamAtravizayaH' . asya DAtoH kevalaM sArvaDAtukapratyayezu parezu eva rUpARi santi iti asya viDAnasya ASayaH .

info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to explain, to make famous, to elocute
